user.title: Set up MoreRecords
user.description: Enable historical imports and export of Home Assistant Recorder states.

init.title: MoreRecords – import or export
init.description: Choose whether to import historical data or export existing Recorder history as a CSV file.

confirm.title: Confirm historical import

data.confirm: I have a backup and want to import the missing rows
data.confirm_complete_history: I confirm CCU-Historian has retained every state change for this datapoint throughout the selected query period

csv.title: Upload CSV file
csv.description: Upload a timestamp/value CSV. On/off states are supported for lights and switches. MoreRecords skips existing HA history and rows outside retention.

historian_connect.title: Connect to CCU-Historian
historian_connect.description:
Enter the CCU-Historian web address (including port). The API key is optional and is stored in the integration options.

Last connection diagnostic: {diagnostic}

historian_search.title: Search CCU-Historian datapoints
historian_search.description: Search by display name, parameter, interface or address. Leave blank to browse the first 100 entries. Continue to select from the matching results.

historian_point.title: Choose datapoint and time period
historian_point.description:
Select a datapoint and a time range. With auto_purge enabled, MoreRecords fetches only the portion within the configured retention window. Existing HA history is never overwritten.

Last data validation error: {diagnostic}

If CCU-Historian returns different values at the exact same timestamp, MoreRecords keeps the last value from the source and reports the number of collisions before confirmation.

With daily supports enabled, the complete selected Historian window is queried, allowing genuine pre-cutoff observations to seed the first eligible midnight without inserting those expired originals.

import.title: Import historical data
import.description:
Choose an existing entity, source and the required transition-state policy. Existing Recorder state rows and their exact timestamps are preserved. Only missing source timestamps are added.

Daily support rows are off by default. When enabled, they copy only a previously observed source state inside the selected import window to local midnight. A real source or Recorder state between 00:00 and 06:00 suppresses the day's support row.

data.gap_mode: State in the gap before existing Recorder history
data.daily_midnight_support: Create daily 00:00 support rows from imported observations (optional)

export.title: Export Recorder states
export.description: Choose entity, start and end date/time. Times without UTC offsets use Home Assistant timezone. Start included, end excluded. Last diagnostic: {diagnostic}

export_confirm.title: Confirm CSV export

export_download.title: Download CSV
export_download.description:
CSV export for **{entity_id}** ({count} raw rows):

**[Download CSV file]({download_url})**

The link is valid for ten minutes and can be used only once. Click Submit after downloading to finish.

error.invalid_entity: Select an existing entity included in Home Assistant Recorder history.
error.sqlite_only: This version supports only the SQLite recorder.
error.purge_enabled: Automatic purge is enabled; only points inside the configured purge_keep_days window may be imported.
error.invalid_csv: The CSV is invalid or its values do not match the entity type. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.missing_history: The selected entity has no existing recorder history.
error.overlap: CSV timestamps must all precede the earliest existing recorder state.
error.confirmation_required: You must explicitly confirm the import.
error.import_failed: The import failed and was rolled back. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.historian_connection: Could not connect to CCU-Historian or load datapoints; check the URL, port and API key.
error.no_datapoints: No matching datapoints. Try a different search.
error.invalid_point: The selected datapoint is no longer in the search results.
error.unit_mismatch: CCU-Historian unit differs from the target entity unit. Automatic conversion is not supported.
error.historian_empty: No historical readings found in this period.
error.historian_data: Could not load or validate this datapoint's historical values. See the logs.
error.no_new_data: All source rows are already covered by Home Assistant's Recorder history.
error.retention_empty: No historical source data are eligible within the active Recorder retention interval. Nothing was imported.
error.export_invalid: Invalid date/time interval. Review the diagnostic.
error.export_empty: No Recorder states in the selected range.
error.export_too_large: More than 100,000 rows; choose a shorter interval.
error.export_failed: Could not read Recorder data. See the logs.
error.coverage_confirmation_required: Explicitly confirm that the CCU-Historian query is complete.
error.coverage_verification_failed: The import may have succeeded, but verified CCU-Historian history could not be certified. Check the import result and log; no continuity evidence was saved.
error.invalid_gap_mode: Choose a valid state for the gap after imported history.
